sources.title: Be Ready: be ready for emergencies (UK Government)
Be Ready (UK Government): three days of supplies

rules.text: Bottled water for drinking: 3 litres per person per day. Add more for cooking and washing.
Non-perishable food that needs no fridge or cooking, such as tinned meat, fish or vegetables, dried fruit and nuts. The site gives no calorie figure; 2,000 kcal per person per day is an assumption.
